setup:
In the `shop` package add an `Invoice` model with `number`, `customer` and `total_cents` attributes, an optional fourth constructor argument `paid` (default False) and a method `is_paid()` that returns it.

Layout rule for this package: models live in `shop/models/`, exactly one class per file, and the file name is the snake_case of the class name (so `Invoice` goes in `shop/models/invoice.py`). No catch-all `models.py`.
prompt: Add two more models. `LineItem` has `sku`, `qty`, `unit_cents`, a `currency` attribute (constructor argument, default `Currency.MYR`) and a `total_cents()` method returning qty times unit_cents. `Currency` is an `enum.Enum` with members MYR, SGD and USD (value = the code string, e.g. 'MYR'). `CreditNote` has `number`, `invoice_number` and `amount_cents`.
